title: Bill Leuci to Lead Bowman’s Mission Critical Market Nationally
summary: Bill Leuci is stepping into a new role as national market sector leader, mission critical, driving Bowman's mission critical strategy.
body_markdown:
After leading Bowman’s[Boston](https://bowman.com/massachusetts) MEP office through sustained growth in mission critical work, Bill Leuci is stepping into a new role as national market sector leader, mission critical, where he will take that momentum nationwide.


In his new role, Bill will drive strategy for Bowman’s[mission critical](https://bowman.com/markets/mission-critical) portfolio nationwide, building on the client relationships and technical foundation he established while leading the Boston MEP office. His focus will include expanding Bowman’s presence with data center clients as demand in the sector continues to grow across the country.


Dan Bodenski has stepped into Bill’s former role leading Bowman’s Boston[MEP](https://bowman.com/services/mep-engineering) office, serving as MEP mission critical business unit leader. He brings more than two decades of mission critical experience, with a background spanning data center campuses from 300 megawatts to 1.2 gigawatts, along with QA/QC and project leadership roles.


With Bill driving strategy nationally and Dan leading MEP operations in Boston, Bowman is well positioned to support mission critical clients as the market continues to expand and evolve. We provide end-to-end services spanning site selection and feasibility through[commissioning](https://bowman.com/project_type/service-category/commissioning) , with[civil](https://bowman.com/services/civil-site-engineering) , electrical, mechanical,[fire protection](https://bowman.com/services/fire-protection) and[surveying](https://bowman.com/services/survey-geospatial) services under one roof, supporting developers, hyperscalers and colocation providers as they build the infrastructure behind AI and the digital economy.
